name: Harden Vanilla Puppeteer
notes: Patches cover Puppeteer 1.19.0, 2.1.1, 5.2.1, 5.3.1 and 7.0.1 and Puppeteer Core 5.3.1, plus a universal srcdoc patch in ./src. Scripts injected with page.evaluateOnNewDocument() still run in the main world.
summary: Patch-package diffs that edit core Puppeteer files to run page calls in an isolated world and strip Puppeteer strings from error traces and profile names, lowering automation detection.
